name: OpenRouter
summary: One API for many AI models.

flows.title: Find a model in the catalogue
steps: Go to openrouter.ai and select Models in the top navigation. The catalogue renders without signing in.
Type part of a model's name into the Search models… box above the list.
Narrow the list with the two dropdowns and the checkboxes beside that box, and with the row of tabs that begins with All.
Switch between List view and Table view with the pair of tabs above the list; Pinned limits it to the ones you pinned.
Select a model's name to open its own page, or Discover Models to browse them by what they are for.
